newsitem.title: USA: CME traders call USDA data bullish for CME bellies.
newsitem.headline: CME traders call USDA data bullish for CME bellies.

text.p: CME traders and analysts called USDA's Cold Storage report bullish for CME pork belly futures and said they expect futures to open 0.50 to 2.00 cents per lb higher Monday.
USDA reported frozen pork belly supplies as of February 1 at 38.041 million lbs, which was less than analysts' estimates that ranged from 39.7 million to 43.2 million.
"The usage rate in January was certainly better than the visible warehouses stocks insinuated," said Chuck Levitt, senior livestock analyst at Alaron Trading Corp.
While supplies increased in warehouses used in the Chicago Mercantile Exchange's weekly published storage report, supplies apparently decreased in non-reporting warehouses, he said.
